parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `SecretsResponse` in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/AuthNetworkClientE2ETests.swift` — carries `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone. The `SecretsResponse` type-alias lives inside an E2E test file and almost certainly mirrors the shape of the production `AppSecrets` type-alias in `AppServices/AppConfiguration.swift` deliberately, so that the test can decode a real network response without importing production internals. Lifting the shared shape into a common location would couple production `AppServices` to test semantics, which is the canonical restraint pattern.
